inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust settles on the iron gate,
Rust crawls up the rusted plate.
The soil swells, the silence cracks,
Black petals blooming from the backs
Of graves we paid to keep them deep.
They drink the poison, plant the creep.

[Chorus]
Bone Orchard blooming in the night,
Roots twist tight in the town's own sight.
Every lie we buried sprouts,
In the soil, the rot erupts.

[Verse]
The mayor walks with hollow eyes,
Choking smoke beneath the skies.
His shadow stretches, long and thin,
Pulling him beneath the skin
Of the earth that used to hold
The truth he sold to buy his gold.

[Chorus]
Bone Orchard blooming in the night,
Roots twist tight in the town's own sight.
Every lie we buried sprouts,
In the soil, the rot erupts.

[Bridge]
Bass hums low, the ground begins to shake.
The flowers open for the sake
Of something hungry, something old,
Waiting for the story's told.

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Bone Orchard blooming in the night,
Roots twist tight in the town's own sight.
Every lie we buried sprouts,
In the soil, the rot erupts.

[Outro]
The roots grip down, the town is swallowed whole.
Bone Orchard blooms in the silent soul.
